UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores core details and aggregated performance of Mock Mitra users.

name.description: The user's real or preferred name from Google sign-in.

email.description: The email address linked to the user's Google account.

exam.description: The competitive exam the user is preparing for (e.g., SSC CGL, UPSC).

language.description: The language selection (e.g., Hinglish, English, Hindi).

customExamDetails.description: Additional custom curriculum descriptions if preparing for other exams.

onboarded.description: Indicates whether the user has finalized initial onboarding selection.

streak.description: Current active daily practice streak count.

strongTopics.description: Topics where the user has achieved high accuracy.

weakTopics.description: Topics requiring urgent focus or drill practice.

knowledgeProfile.description: Key-value pair of topic accuracy trends (0 - 100).

lastAiAnalysis.description: The last AI analysis results cached for performance view.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

TestResult.title: TestResult
TestResult.description: Stores individual mock test results completed by the user.

date.description: The exact date and time the mock test was taken.

score.description: Total correct answers scored by the user.

total.description: Total number of questions in the test.

timeSpent.description: Time spent during the test in seconds.

subject.description: The exam subject name or full mock indicator.

topicPerformance.description: Breakdown of accuracy and count for each topic in the test.

questions.description: The questions loaded during the active test session.

users/{userId}.description: Root collection for user registration and aggregate analytics.

users/{userId}/tests/{testId}.description: Subcollection to isolate individual test histories dynamically and prevent document sizing overflow.
